hero.title: Learning for Impact: Agency, Future Readiness, and Purpose in Higher Education
hero.sub: Bringing together faculty, learning designers, and academic leaders across the Arab region
hero.when_where: 2–3 February 2027 · Abu Dhabi University, Abu Dhabi Campus

about.title: Advancing learning that truly delivers impact
body: The inaugural ACTLC Conference brings together academic leaders, faculty, and teaching and learning professionals from across the region for a gathering focused on learning for impact — advancing agency, future readiness, and purpose in higher education.

At a time when higher education is under increasing pressure to demonstrate its relevance and societal impact, this conference positions learning at the center of transformation, focusing on how institutions can intentionally design teaching, learning, and assessment to develop future-ready graduates with agency, adaptability, and purpose.

goals.title: Embed employability and purpose into the student experience
goals.text: Design learning that prepares graduates for real workforce challenges

goals.title: Reimagine assessment as a driver of capability and agency
goals.text: Move beyond grading toward authentic, evidence-based evaluation

goals.title: Leverage AI and digital technologies responsibly and effectively
goals.text: Enhance human judgment rather than replace it

goals.title: Design personalised, inclusive, and flexible learning pathways at scale
goals.text: Equity-driven approaches that reach every learner

themes.title: Four Sub-Themes, One Direction
themes.lead: All proposals must align with one of the four sub-themes. Practice-led. Evidence-informed. 500–1,000 words.

items.title: Future-Ready Curricula and Graduates
points: Aligning graduate attributes with workforce and societal needs
Curriculum renewal for relevance, adaptability, and employability
Co-designing curricula with employers, industry, and communities
Interdisciplinary and challenge-based learning
Micro-credentials, stackable learning, and lifelong learning pathways
Measuring and evidencing graduate outcomes

items.title: Assessment Reimagined for Capability and Agency
points: Real-world, performance-based, and programmatic assessment
Assessment that builds confidence, autonomy, and learner agency
Portfolios, capstones, and reflective practice
Rethinking grading, feedback, and progression
Ensuring coherence, academic standards, and progression integrity

items.title: Teaching & Learning in an AI- and Data-Rich Environment
points: Blended, hybrid, and digitally enhanced learning models
AI as a co-pilot for teaching, learning design, and assessment
Learning analytics and evidence-informed teaching
Ethical use of data and educational technologies
Enhancing rather than replacing human judgment
Faculty capability and digital pedagogy development

items.title: Personalised, Flexible, and Inclusive Learning at Scale
points: Designing personalised learning experiences at institutional scale
Flexible learning models and pathways
Equity-driven personalisation and inclusive pedagogies
Technology-enabled advising and learner support systems
Supporting student success, belonging, and well-being

blocks.title: Proposal Structure (500–1,000 words)
items: Cover page: title, sub-theme alignment, author & institution details
Context & challenge: institutional setting and problem addressed
The practice or innovation: what was designed or changed, who was involved
Implementation: how introduced, scope, scale, and timeline
Impact & evidence: outcomes, qualitative and quantitative indicators
Lessons learned & transferability: what other institutions can adapt
